name: Uzzah
title: The Man Who Touched the Ark of the Covenant
summary: Uzzah was the son of Abinadab, in whose house the Ark of the Covenant had been kept for many years. He is best known for his death when he reached out his hand to steady the Ark during its transport to Jerusalem, and God struck him down because he touched the holy object. His death served as a warning about the importance of respecting God's holiness and following His commands.

keyEvents.title: The Ark of the Covenant Kept at Abinadab's House
keyEvents.description: The Ark of the Covenant was placed in Abinadab's house after it was returned from the Philistines, and Uzzah and his brother Ahio were responsible for it.

keyEvents.title: Transporting the Ark of the Covenant on a New Cart
keyEvents.description: David decided to move the Ark of the Covenant to Jerusalem, and Uzzah and Ahio drove the new cart on which the Ark was placed.

keyEvents.title: Uzzah Touches the Ark of the Covenant
keyEvents.description: When the oxen stumbled at Nod's threshing floor, Uzzah reached out his hand and grabbed the Ark of the Covenant to prevent it from falling.

keyEvents.title: God's Wrath and Uzzah's Death
keyEvents.description: The Lord was angry with Uzzah for his irreverence, and God struck him down there by the ark. He died by God's ark.

keyEvents.title: David becomes afraid and angry
keyEvents.description: David's joy at bringing the ark to Jerusalem turned into fear and anger over the Lord's outburst against Uzzah, and he named the place Perez-uzzah.

keyEvents.title: The account in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: The parallel account in 1 Chronicles retells the event and emphasizes that Uzzah died because he reached out his hand toward the ark.
